req.title: Reject non-string title
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field is not a string.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-003 requires HTTP 422 when the title field is not a string. We need: (1) a positive case confirming a valid string title returns 201, (2) negative cases for each non-string type (integer, boolean, null, array, object) returning exactly 422, and (3) boundary cases at the edge of type coercion (e.g., numeric-looking string is valid, bare integer is not). Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting the exact status code 422 (not >= 400), asserting 201 for the positive path, and checking the response body structure. We cover both sides of the type-check: string (passes) vs non-string (fails). The in-process FastAPI TestClient is used with an in-memory SQLite DB to keep tests deterministic and idempotent.

tests.name: test_create_task_valid_string_title_returns_201
actions: POST /tasks/ with title as a valid non-empty string
expected: Response JSON contains 'id', 'title' matching input, 'completed' false
trace: R-TASK-003: positive equivalence partition — string title is accepted
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
import json

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_create_task_valid_string_title_returns_201():
    payload = {"title": "Valid string title", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Valid string title"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "id" in body
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)

test_create_task_valid_string_title_returns_201()

tests.name: test_create_task_missing_title_returns_422
actions: POST /tasks/ with title field entirely absent from payload
expected: Response body contains 'detail' with at least one error referencing 'title'
trace: R-TASK-003: absent title is a boundary of non-string — must return 422; BVA at the presence/absence boundary
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_create_task_missing_title_returns_422():
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    assert isinstance(body["detail"], list)
    assert len(body["detail"]) >= 1
    locs = [str(err.get("loc", "")) for err in body["detail"]]
    assert any("title" in loc for loc in locs)

test_create_task_missing_title_returns_422()

tests.name: test_create_task_integer_title_not_201
actions: POST /tasks/ with title as integer 0 (zero — boundary numeric value)
trace: R-TASK-003: integer 0 is not a string; asserts exact 422 to catch mutations flipping to 400 or 200; NEG + comparison-mutation
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_create_task_integer_title_not_201():
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": 0, "completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 422
    assert r.status_code != 201
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 400
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body

test_create_task_integer_title_not_201()
